target: TitlePoint (line of business of Black Knight, Inc.)

deal_value.notes: US$225M all cash. Announced November 18, 2022 (8-K filed); expected close December 2022 / closed early 2023. FNF exercised a contractual repurchase right on TitlePoint triggered by ICE's change-of-control acquisition of Black Knight.

inputs: US$225M cash purchase price — https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/fidelity-national-financial-to-acquire-titlepoint-from-black-knight-301683128.html and FNF 8-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001331875/000133187522000093/ex991pressreleasedatednove.htm

TitlePoint ~US$10M revenue in Q3 2022 (incl. $7.2M sensitive to home-buying/origination volumes), per Black Knight, reported by trade press — https://www.inman.com/2022/11/23/fidelity-paying-black-knight-225m-to-bring-titlepoint-back-into-the-fold/ and https://www.housingwire.com/articles/black-knight-to-sell-titlepoint-back-to-fidelity-for-225m/
calculable.caveats: Revenue input is a single quarter (Q3 2022) annualized, not an audited full-year standalone figure; TitlePoint sat inside Black Knight's Data & Analytics segment with no separate annual disclosure. Q3 2022 was also a depressed origination environment, so the run-rate may understate normalized revenue.

sources.title: PR Newswire — Fidelity National Financial to Acquire TitlePoint from Black Knight
Black Knight Form 8-K press release exhibit (Nov 18, 2022)
HousingWire — Black Knight to sell TitlePoint back to Fidelity for $225M
Inman — Fidelity Paying Black Knight $225M to Bring TitlePoint Back Into the Fold (Q3 2022 revenue figure)
ALTA — Fidelity to Acquire TitlePoint from Black Knight for $225M

notes: Typo resolution: 'National Financial' = Fidelity National Financial (FNF). No multiple was published. The ~$10M Q3 2022 TitlePoint revenue figure (attributed to Black Knight) appeared consistently across Inman/HousingWire search results, but the articles themselves returned 403 to direct fetch, so the exact wording is unverified — treated as a soft input, hence 'partially_calculable' rather than 'calculable'. FNF originally sold Property Insight/TitlePoint to Black Knight in 2014 with a change-of-control repurchase right, exercised after ICE agreed to buy Black Knight in May 2022.
